answer: Cross-Site Labor Ledger. Each identity must continuously perform verified physical work at distinct, geotagged sites: planting in a garden, sediment sampling on a dune, flow gauging at a river. A witness device signs each task with location and time; identities sharing sites or devices get collapsed. Faking N identities costs N separate field visits with N device registrations, so attacker labor and travel scale linearly with the sybil count, not the credential count.
